hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: The portfolio is heavily weighted to crypto, with the cross‑asset regime indicating risk_on. However, the majority of signals are flat or have placeholder risk metrics (zero vol, zero expected shortfall) and several assets show negative composites or institutional factor scores, suggesting fragility. To preserve capital we stay neutral overall and modestly scale back conviction across the board.
